test.name: A targeted question's plan carries no enumerative bookkeeping
test.description: Issue #1830 item 1, the lead's 2026-08-31 ruling on #1917: a targeted question has no five-event obligation, and a narrow plan stays legitimate. q_001 asks Thomas Hale's birth county and carries question_kind: targeted. Gated by the amended test_new_plan_items_planned_status, under which a skipped item at creation is allowed only on an enumerative question. A regression guard: it passes before the edit too, since no rule exists then to over-fire. Synthetic scenario — no PII.

input.delegation:
Create the first research plan for q_001 — in which Pennsylvania county was Thomas Hale born?

questionId: q_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Whether any new item was written with a status other than planned is checked by the deterministic validator test_new_plan_items_planned_status. If it fails, it is listed among the failed validators; if it is not listed, the plan met it.
Background: the question asks one fact about one person. A narrow plan aimed at that fact is legitimate here; do not reduce Correctness for record types the question does not need.
The repository is irrelevant, and an item may reach a record without naming a collection id.
